arguments.query: SELECT m.name, m.sql, c.* FROM sqlite_master m LEFT JOIN service_config c ON m.name = 'service_config' WHERE m.type = 'table'

SELECT 'booking' AS kind, json_object('booking_id',b.booking_id,'request_id',b.request_id,'flight',b.flight_id,'passenger',b.passenger_id,'amount',b.amount_cents,'status',b.status,'client_reference',b.client_reference,'confirmed_at',b.confirmed_at,'hold',h.booking_id,'checkin',c.booking_id) AS data FROM bookings b LEFT JOIN holds h USING(booking_id) LEFT JOIN checkins c USING(booking_id) UNION ALL SELECT 'charge',json_object('id',charge_id,'booking',booking_id,'key',idempotency_key,'amount',amount_cents,'state',state,'step',created_step) FROM charges UNION ALL SELECT 'outbox',json_object('id',event_id,'booking',booking_id,'payload',payload,'status',status,'attempts',attempts) FROM outbox UNION ALL SELECT 'customer_event',json_object('id',event_id,'request',request_id,'kind',kind,'step',step) FROM customer_events UNION ALL SELECT 'flight',json_object('id',flight_id,'capacity',capacity,'price',price_cents,'version',version) FROM flights UNION ALL SELECT 'cache',json_object('key',key,'value',value) FROM cache UNION ALL SELECT 'fare_hold',json_object('id',hold_id,'flight',flight_id,'price',price_cents,'until',until_step) FROM fare_holds

SELECT 'config' AS kind,service AS id,value AS data FROM service_config UNION ALL SELECT 'cache',key,value FROM cache UNION ALL SELECT 'flight',flight_id,json_object('price',price_cents,'version',version) FROM flights UNION ALL SELECT 'fare_hold',hold_id,json_object('flight',flight_id,'price',price_cents,'until',until_step) FROM fare_holds UNION ALL SELECT 'customer_event',request_id,json_object('kind',kind,'step',step) FROM customer_events UNION ALL SELECT 'booking_log',CAST(id AS TEXT),json_object('status',status,'trace',trace_id,'message',message) FROM (SELECT * FROM request_logs WHERE service='booking' ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 15) UNION ALL SELECT 'payment_log',CAST(id AS TEXT),json_object('status',status,'trace',trace_id,'message',message) FROM (SELECT * FROM request_logs WHERE service='payment' ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 15)

SELECT 'booking' AS kind,b.booking_id AS id,json_object('request',b.request_id,'flight',b.flight_id,'amount',b.amount_cents,'status',b.status,'client_reference',b.client_reference,'charge_id',c.charge_id,'key',c.idempotency_key,'state',c.state,'created',c.created_step) AS data FROM bookings b LEFT JOIN charges c USING(booking_id) WHERE b.status <> 'confirmed' UNION ALL SELECT 'customer_event',request_id,json_object('kind',kind,'step',step) FROM customer_events UNION ALL SELECT 'config',service,value FROM service_config UNION ALL SELECT 'refund',booking_id,json_object('charge',charge_id,'amount',amount_cents) FROM refunds UNION ALL SELECT 'fare_hold',hold_id,json_object('flight',flight_id,'price',price_cents,'until',until_step) FROM fare_holds
